D: Indy, a singer and a kid end up in India trying to recover sacred stones stolen from a village.
P: Serve the banquet when the Pankot Palace dinner is brought out.
S: Club Obi Wan prawn har gow
the Shanghai nightclub where it all kicks off

Translucent pleated prawn dumplings with bamboo shoot and ginger, steamed until glassy, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Chop 400g peeled green prawns roughly with 50g bamboo shoots, grated ginger, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour and salt. Fill 24 round gow gee wrappers, fold and pleat closed. Steam on baking paper over boiling water for 6 minutes until the wrappers turn glassy. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tsp chilli oil for dipping.
the banquet's snake dish, made with sausages
Long thin sausages coiled on a platter and glazed with mango chutney and chilli, a jug of spiced yoghurt alongside. Surprise.
the kid who keeps Indy alive
Potato and pea filling with cumin, chilli and garam masala, folded into pastry cones, fried at 175C until blistered. Tamarind chutney.
M: the village whose sacred stone was taken

Chickpeas in tomato onion masala, yellow dal tempered with mustard seed and cumin, turmeric roasted cauliflower, basmati, warm flatbread and mango pickle. Simmer 200g yellow split peas with turmeric in 1L water for 40 minutes, then pour over 1 tsp mustard seeds and 1 tsp cumin sizzled in 2 tbsp ghee. Soften an onion with garlic, ginger and 2 tsp garam masala, add 400g tomatoes and 2 tins chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes. Roast a cauliflower in florets with turmeric and oil at 220C for 25 minutes. Cook 300g basmati. Warm 4 flatbreads and serve with mango pickle.

Lamb shoulder marinated overnight in yoghurt, ginger, garlic and garam masala, onions cooked down slowly until deep brown, tomato added, the lamb braised covered at 160C for 2.5 hours until tender. Basmati rice.
W: the chilled monkey brains, made with mango
Mango purée sweetened, gelatine bloomed and stirred through, whipped cream folded in, set in small dome moulds for 4 hours and turned out onto plates with a little passionfruit.
K: Ripe mango blended with yoghurt, cold milk, honey, cardamom and a pinch of saffron until frothy, topped with crushed pistachios. Soak a pinch of saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 minutes. Blend 2 ripe mangoes with 400g natural yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 2 tbsp honey, a pinch of ground cardamom and the saffron milk until smooth and frothy. Pour over ice into four glasses and top with crushed pistachios.

s.note: the kid who keeps Indy alive
s.how: Cook 500g diced potatoes with 150g peas, 1 tsp cumin, chilli and 1 tsp garam masala. Mix 250g flour with 3 tbsp oil and water into a stiff dough. Roll, cut, shape into cones, fill and fry at 175C until blistered. Serve with tamarind chutney.

s.note: the banquet's snake dish, made with sausages
s.how: Coil 500g chipolatas tightly on a tray, pinning with skewers. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes, brushing with 3 tbsp mango chutney and a chopped chilli. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with cumin to serve alongside. Surprise.

m.how: Marinate 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder in 200g yoghurt, ginger, garlic and 2 tsp garam masala overnight. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly until deep brown, add a tin of tomatoes, then the lamb. Braise covered at 160C for 2.5 hours. Serve with 300g basmati.

w.note: the chilled monkey brains, made with mango
w.how: Blitz 2 mangoes with 60g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine leaves, dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through. Fold in 250ml whipped cream. Set in 4 dome moulds for 4 hours, turn out and top with passionfruit pulp.

d.how: Soak a pinch of saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 minutes. Blend 2 ripe mangoes with 400g natural yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 2 tbsp honey, a pinch of ground cardamom and the saffron milk until smooth and frothy. Pour over ice into four glasses and top with crushed pistachios.
